fact: On 19 January 2023 the Ministry of Justice officially launched the informatisation of case management for the judicial system, won in an international tender by the firm Synergy and financed among others by UNDP, the minister naming the Polícia and the Polícia Judiciária among the bodies it would change; it is to run in two phases, criminal procedure first, and the project had begun more than five years earlier without advancing.
title: Ministério da Justiça lança o processo de informatização da gestão processual do sistema judiciário
